transcript.text: If you want someone to do something and
they're not doing it, you have like four
or five reasons that they're not doing
it. The first is they just didn't know
that you wanted them to do it.
[laughter]
Most common, hey, did you do that thing?
And they're like, what thing? You're
like, damn it, I didn't write it down,
did I? So now I say, why didn't you do
that thing? They say, well, I didn't
know how to do it. Okay, now let's say
we train them. So I told you that you
needed to do it. You know how to do it,
but you didn't know when. Oh, I need to
do that tomorrow. The next is you have
something that's blocking you. So I knew
that. I knew how. Well, I knew you
wanted to do it tomorrow, but you also
told me to do three other things.
Which one did you want me to do?
Finally, you get into this, which is
that I didn't want to do it, which in my
experience is the first place that we go
to as entrepreneurs and typically the
last one that's reality. Most people, I
have found when they have a job, prefer
to keep it. And I've also found that
most people prefer to feel like they're
doing a good job at their job. It's
usually one of these other issues.
